Ask Dana Whitfield who will fly the dock and what the estate needs it for. Operator training isn't included, and the only stated purpose is the installer's order note: mapping the whole estate.

extra_risks.text: Usage: 0 flights in each of the 7 weeks on record, while the dock was online all 7 days of every week.
No commissioning flight on record. The dock was last seen online on 13 November 2026.
No open tickets: the only ticket, FB-10923 (dock registered), closed the day it opened. Dana Whitfield's request never became a ticket and is still open.
The installer that sold, installed and was invoiced no longer answers its phone or email.
Invoice INV-26-0921 (£14,000, first year) was paid by the reseller on 14 September 2026. The term runs to 13 September 2027, with no automatic renewal.
Operator training, FlytBase onboarding and any site survey are not included.
